name: – Konstantinos Arvanitis – § 55 – Am 17
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: 55. Urges the Member States, candidate and potential candidate countries to ensure prompt, thorough and impartial investigations of corruption cases, with particular priority given to cases involving high-level officials, in order to safeguard the rule of law, uphold public trust and ensure accountability at all levels of government; calls, furthermore on the Member States to follow up on such cases within a reasonable time frame so as not to foster a sense of impunity among citizens; notes with concern instances of the persecution of public officials who have exposed corruption and contributed to the criminal conviction of high-level officials; considers such a policy of retaliation and revenge to be unacceptable;
